about.text: Crafting light that transforms spaces and elevates everyday moments since 2010

LUMINA was born from a simple belief: that light is not just functional—it's transformative. Founded by architect Elena Vasquez, our journey began in a small Brooklyn studio with a mission to create lighting that marries form and function, artistry and engineering.

What started as a passion project quickly grew into a movement, attracting designers, architects, and homeowners who sought something beyond the ordinary. Today, LUMINA stands as a beacon of thoughtful design, with our fixtures illuminating homes, restaurants, galleries, and hotels across the globe.
"Light is the soul of architecture. It reveals form, creates mood, and transforms ordinary spaces into extraordinary experiences." — Elena Vasquez, Founder
Every fixture is meticulously designed to balance aesthetic beauty with optimal functionality, creating pieces that stand the test of time.
Each piece is crafted by skilled artisans who pour their expertise and passion into every detail, ensuring unparalleled quality.
We're committed to eco-friendly practices, using energy-efficient LEDs and sustainable materials without compromising on beauty.

To create lighting that enhances the way people live, work, and connect with their spaces—delivering warmth, inspiration, and timeless elegance through thoughtful design and exceptional craftsmanship.

Every LUMINA fixture begins as a sketch, a vision of how light should dance and interact with space. Our designers collaborate with engineers to push the boundaries of what's possible, creating fixtures that are as technically advanced as they are beautiful.

From hand-blown glass to precision-machined metal components, each element is carefully selected and crafted. Our artisans spend hours perfecting each piece, ensuring that every LUMINA fixture meets our exacting standards of quality and beauty.
Elena Vasquez founds LUMINA in her Brooklyn studio, creating the first collection of handcrafted pendant lights.
We open our flagship showroom in Manhattan, showcasing our growing collection to architects and designers.
LUMINA pledges to use 100% recyclable packaging and energy-efficient LEDs across all collections.
Our fixtures illuminate spaces in over 30 countries, from private residences to world-class hotels.
Launch of our smart lighting collection and expansion into sustainable material innovation.
With a background in architecture and a passion for light, Elena leads our creative vision with unwavering dedication to beauty and function.
Marcus brings over 15 years of experience in industrial design, specializing in the intersection of form and function.
Sarah's expertise in glass blowing brings our most intricate designs to life, each piece uniquely beautiful.
David ensures every fixture meets rigorous safety and performance standards while pushing technological boundaries.

We believe in creating lighting that lasts—not just in durability, but in timeless design. Our commitment extends beyond beautiful products to sustainable practices, ethical manufacturing, and a dedication to our community.

contact.text: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out with any questions, feedback, or custom lighting inquiries.
What is the warranty on your lighting products?

All LUMINA lighting products come with a 5-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and LED components. This warranty does not cover damage from improper installation, misuse, or normal wear and tear. For detailed warranty information, please refer to the documentation included with your product or contact our support team.
How do I determine the right size light fixture for my space?

A general rule is to add the room dimensions in feet and convert that sum to inches for the ideal fixture diameter. For dining tables, the fixture should be 12 inches narrower than the table width. Height-wise, pendants should hang 30-36 inches above a table surface. Our lighting specialists are available to help you make the perfect selection.
Do you offer custom lighting design services?

Yes! Our design team specializes in custom lighting solutions for residential and commercial projects. We offer personalized consultations to understand your vision and create bespoke fixtures tailored to your space. The process includes initial design concepts, material selection, and final fabrication. Contact our custom design team to get started.
What is your return and exchange policy?

We offer a 30-day return policy for unused items in original packaging. Custom orders are final sale. To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team with your order number. Return shipping is free for defective items; otherwise, shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.
How do I care for and clean my lighting fixtures?

For most fixtures, use a soft, dry microfiber cloth to gently wipe away dust. For glass components, use a damp cloth with mild soap and dry immediately. Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, or excess moisture. Always turn off power and allow bulbs to cool before cleaning. For specific care instructions, please refer to the product manual included with your fixture.

What is the warranty on your lighting products?

All LUMINA lighting products come with a 5-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and LED components. This warranty does not cover damage from improper installation, misuse, or normal wear and tear. For detailed warranty information, please refer to the documentation included with your product or contact our support team.

A general rule is to add the room dimensions in feet and convert that sum to inches for the ideal fixture diameter. For dining tables, the fixture should be 12 inches narrower than the table width. Height-wise, pendants should hang 30-36 inches above a table surface. Our lighting specialists are available to help you make the perfect selection.
Do you offer custom lighting design services?

Yes! Our design team specializes in custom lighting solutions for residential and commercial projects. We offer personalized consultations to understand your vision and create bespoke fixtures tailored to your space. Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, or excess moisture. Always turn off power and allow bulbs to cool before cleaning. For specific care instructions, please refer to the product manual included with your fixture.
